ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% low-intensity (black) pixels in the central and basal areas and 25% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated along the trailing margins and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central mass is a contiguous low-intensity block. Left distal region contains white mottling with approximately 6-8 distinct circular low-intensity spots. Right distal region shows vertical high-contrast linear streaks (black on white) transitioning into a solid white tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 1/8th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration. Multiple jagged peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels across the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve extending from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep that terminates in sharply upward-tilted lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast, raised pixel structures (barnacles) are localized on the extreme lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark vertical rake-like streaks on the white background of the right lobe; horizontal white linear disruptions visible on the dark background of the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) on the outer tips; irregular jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the left lobe suggest minor historic tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique constellation of small, dark, circular spots located on the inner-white portion of the left lobe's trailing edge.
